title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior diffuses through a population over time under social influence, public health policies, and communication effects.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe the fraction of neighbors wearing masks and adjust their adoption probability accordingly.

interactions.name: policy_influence
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement increase perceived cost of non-compliance and raise adoption likelihood.

interactions.name: public_health_communication
interactions.description: Campaigns and messages increase risk perception and trust, nudging adoption upward.

interactions.name: misinformation_spread
interactions.description: Background misinformation reduces risk perception and trust, and can increase fatigue.

interactions.name: fatigue_decay
interactions.description: Sustained compliance increases fatigue over time, which can lead to dropping mask use absent countervailing influences.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate on the last simulation day.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption first reaches or exceeds 70%; undefined if never reached.

metrics.name: area_under_adoption_curve
metrics.description: Sum of adoption rates over time (normalized by duration) to capture both speed and magnitude of adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic groups (e.g., Gini or coefficient of variation of group adoption rates).

metrics.name: noncompliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Average fraction of individuals not wearing masks during periods when a mandate is active.
